scope: Descriptive source inspection after global validation selection freeze. No holdout results accessed; no novelty claim; source is unchanged.
label: Halton initialization with stagnation-aware incumbent search
first_points: Use deterministic Halton points for the first 2*d evaluations, mapped to the legal bounds.
incumbent: Sort observed points by value. The base is the best point with probability 0.5, otherwise a uniformly chosen member of the best quarter.
stagnation: Count observations since the latest strict best-value improvement. Uniform exploration probability is 0.03, rising to 0.15 at six stagnant observations and 0.30 at ten. This does not reset history or the objective budget.
adaptation: Base sigma=0.3*(1-0.8*n/32), floored at 0.05. Multiply by 1.5 after more than five stagnant observations, and independently by three with probability 0.2.
directional_step: With probability 0.3, interpolate between the best and second-best points and add independent Gaussian noise with absolute standard deviation sigma; this branch does not scale sigma by bound width.
other_steps: Otherwise perturb one coordinate with probability 0.3 or all coordinates, scaling Gaussian sigma by each bound width. Thus the directional branch uses smaller noise on this width-ten benchmark.
history_statistics: Uses objective ranking and strict incumbent-improvement timing; best_val is computed but unused.
boundary_handling: Clip every perturbed point coordinatewise; Halton and uniform points are already in bounds.

lineage.description: The seventh generated proposal is selected by validation; all attempted parent-child diffs are exported unchanged.
